notes: Partial run (first pass). WebFetch only opens URLs that surface in search results (provenance), and generic searches were dominated by AgendaPro/job boards/aggregators, so only clinics whose own sites surfaced were opened. 24-hour clinics found: Movet (13, Bogotá/Medellín), VETAS (5), plus own-site 24 h clinics in Bogotá (Zoovet), Medellín/Rionegro/Envigado (evi, San Antonio, CES El Escobero, Maxpuppies), Cali (Supermascotas sur, Servivet, Athenea, Dogspital, Alfa, municipal CBA), Barranquilla (Don Perro, El Country), Cartagena (Veterinaria Cartagena - emergencies by phone), Bucaramanga, Santa Marta (3), Pereira (Vet & Spa, Mascovet), Armenia (Puerto Veterinario). Entries sourced only from the SURA insurer PDF (Pepe Sierra/Virrey/Calle 147/El Country/Pradilla in Bogotá-Chía; Caninos y Felinos, San Lucas, Safari, MeVet in Antioquia) need confirmation from the clinics' own pages. No animal poison line found: CIEMTO-Vet (UdeA animal toxicology advisory) page could not be opened (URL too long for the fetcher; search gave no short URL); the UdeA/other toxicology lines opened are human-only (300 303 8000), so none added. The Movet #909 entry is a clinic-dispatch emergency line, labelled poison_line only because the schema has no 'emergency_line' kind - recommend dropping it from publication. Official duty rota: none exists nationally; IDPYBA Bogotá (123) serves only street animals. Not reachable: unal.edu.co vet faculty (robots), hospitalmisanimales.com (robots), barranquilla.gov.co CBA pages and cartagena.gov.co UMATA page (fetch errors), cambiocolombia article (error), cvzces.com.co (provenance), Javeriana (no clinic page found), COMVEZCOL/CMVZ (not searched successfully). Not covered: San Andrés, Villa de Leyva (no clinic pages found), Cartagena street addresses, Manizales 24 h, Cali Movet (announced 'próximamente'), Tolima hospital hours, Santa Marta/Cartagena beyond the above. Independent check 2026-11-10: opened the source_url of every 24-h entry and of 14 other entries; confirmed names, phones and explicit 24 h text (Movet, VETAS, Zoovet, CES, evi, San Antonio, Supermascotas, CBA Cali, Servivet, Athenea, Dogspital, Alfa, Don Perro, El Country, Cartagena, Bucaramanga, Santa Marta x3, Vet & Spa, Mascovet, Puerto Veterinario); Maxpuppies downgraded (24 h only in title/meta, no phone/address on page); removed the Movet #909 dispatch line and nine entries whose only source was the SURA insurer PDF (no own clinic page found). Follow-up run 2026-11-10 (queue line: San Andrés, Villa de Leyva, Manizales, Javeriana, Universidad Nacional, COMVEZCOL/CMVZ, CIEMTO-Vet, extra 24 h cities). Search returned mostly aggregators (AgendaPro, doctoralia, coolvet, michigatitos, job boards), which are not used as sources; only own sites were opened. Added 9 entries: Cúcuta (Animal Center 24 h; Animal Medical not 24 h), Manizales (ASVET 24/7 claim without phone; Vida Animal, Conexión Animal, La Estrella, U. de Caldas hospital - daytime), Villavicencio (Servicios Veterinarios MV - 'URGENCIAS 24 HORAS' heading only, kept false), Bogotá (Uniagraria, daytime). Rejected: Shuncu Vet (Mexico City, surfaced under a Cúcuta search). Not found / nothing usable: San Andrés (only government vaccination campaign pages, no clinic site), Villa de Leyva (no own clinic pages), Neiva, Pasto, Popayán, Montería, Valledupar (only AgendaPro/aggregators), Javeriana (no hospital page surfaced), Universidad Nacional (unal.edu.co robots-blocked earlier, no new URL), COMVEZCOL/CMVZ (only journal articles and news, no official list/page), CIEMTO-Vet (search surfaced only an elpalpitar.com 2015 news piece about the UdeA human toxicology line; no animal-specific page, so no poison_line added). Unreachable again: cambiocolombia.com public veterinary hospital article (client error twice; skipped). Independent check of the follow-up 2026-11-10: opened the source_url of all 9 new entries; names, phones and addresses confirmed (Animal Center Cúcuta explicit 24 h, 7 days; others as stated), ASVET downgraded to emergency_24h false because the 24/7 text does not identify a Manizales branch, none removed.
